mapper.insert: INSERT INTO monitored_apps (user_id, app_key, display_name, first_seen_at, last_seen_at, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{appKey}, #{displayName}, #{eventTime}, #{eventTime}, #{now}, #{now}) ON CONFLICT (user_id, app_key) DO UPDATE SET display_name = EXCLUDED.display_name, first_seen_at = LEAST(monitored_apps.first_seen_at, EXCLUDED.first_seen_at), last_seen_at = GREATEST(monitored_apps.last_seen_at, EXCLUDED.last_seen_at), updated_at = EXCLUDED.updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM monitored_apps WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY app_key
